spans.s: A technical term used by Pāṇini for उ the sign of the eighth class of roots.
__1 A technical term used by Pāṇini for the termination of the Locative plural. 2 A name for any one of the several case-endings or terminations.

.]] 
__2 Paralyzed, benumbed, insensible; see स्वप्. 
__3 Inactive, dull, latent.

__2 midnight.
